name: doctorcheck-uat
description: DoctorCheck user acceptance tests with Playwright

scripts.format: prettier --write "tests/**/*.ts" playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md scripts/uat-results-data.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "tests/**/*.ts" playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md scripts/uat-results-data.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
